notes: Delray's Chanukah festival and menorah lighting is Sun Dec 6 per the city, Downtown Delray and the Chamber. One tourism listing says Dec 14; that looks like last year's date.
Boca's Holiday Street Parade (Wed Dec 2) runs a new route along NE Mizner Blvd this year because of road work on Federal Hwy.
The Boca PAL Holiday Mile (Dec 2) and the Boca Raton Tribune expos (Dec 5) were canceled and are left off.
Many weekly classes and bar nights skip Thanksgiving Day; only events confirmed for Nov 26 are listed.

picks.title: Boca Ballet Theatre's The Nutcracker
picks.note: The local holiday classic, with Friday night and two Saturday shows.

picks.title: Legends Live Tribute Festival
picks.note: An afternoon of tribute bands under the sky at Sunset Cove. Easy Black Friday plan.

picks.title: Coke Florida Holiday Caravan
picks.note: The Coca-Cola trucks roll up for The Boca Raton's tree lighting. Free and great for kids.

picks.title: Shop Small Sidewalk Sale
picks.note: Atlantic Avenue shops put deals out front for Small Business Saturday.

picks.title: Sharks, Scales & Santa Tales
picks.note: Breakfast with Santa next to the sharks at Sandoway. Book ahead.

picks.title: Delray's 100-Ft Christmas Tree Lighting
picks.note: The big one: the 100-foot tree lights up at 7 and the holiday village opens.

picks.title: 54th Annual Holiday Street Parade
picks.note: Boca's nighttime parade, on a new Mizner Blvd route this year.

picks.title: First Friday Art Walk (Holiday Edition)
picks.note: Galleries stay open late across downtown Delray, with new shows at Arts Warehouse.

picks.title: Wildlife Celebration 2026
picks.note: A free day of animals, crafts and boardwalk walks at Green Cay.

picks.title: Holiday POPS Concert
picks.note: The Symphonia's holiday show at the Mizner Park Amphitheater, with a free kids pre-show.

picks.title: 55th Annual Holiday Tree Lighting
picks.note: Boynton lights its tree at Centennial Park, with a drone show.

picks.title: 26th Annual Downtown Delray Beach Art Festival
picks.note: Two days of artists' booths along the street. Free to walk.

picks.title: Cars & Coffee Palm Beach Holiday Toy Drive
picks.note: Hundreds of cars, and bring a new toy to donate.

picks.title: Chanukah Festival & Menorah Lighting
picks.note: Free festival at Old School Square; the menorah is lit at 6.

picks.title: Holiday Spectacular with Tony DeSare and The Palm Beach Pops
picks.note: The Pops' big holiday show, with Tony DeSare's standards at the piano.

picks.title: Zusha Live in Concert: Chanukah in Downtown Boca
picks.note: Chanukah concert under the sky in Sanborn Square. Kids get a lower price.

picks.title: Holiday Boat Parade
picks.note: Lit-up boats on the Intracoastal. Free, and Boynton Harbor Marina is the best seat.

picks.title: Mindi Abair: I Can't Wait for Christmas (6 PM)
picks.note: Mindi Abair's Christmas show at the Funky Biscuit, one of four this weekend.

picks.title: Delray Beach Holiday Parade: Neon North Pole
picks.note: The big one down Atlantic Ave. Free. Get there early for a curb spot.

picks.title: Blue Lights & Holiday Nights
picks.note: Free family night at Boynton police headquarters.

picks.title: Lynn University Gingerbread Holiday Concert
picks.note: An easy Sunday afternoon holiday concert for the whole family.

picks.title: Delray Beach Twilight Tree Market
picks.note: Evening holiday market at Old School Square. Free to walk.

picks.title: Delray Beach Jingle Bell Jog
picks.note: Saturday morning holiday run from Anchor Park, by the beach.

picks.title: Legends on the Lawn: Soundsations
picks.note: Free concert on the lawn at Canyon Amphitheater. Bring chairs.

picks.title: Winter Wonderland at the Chickee
picks.note: Winter break fun for kids at the Explorium.

hello: Boca's holiday parade has a new route this year because of the Federal Highway work. It runs along NE Mizner Blvd on Wednesday, Dec 2 at 7:30 PM, so plan on parking west of Mizner Park.

openings.name: Pinecrest Bakery
openings.note: Miami Cuban-American bakery chain's newest store, with pastelitos, croquetas and cafe con leche, in a former Boston Market

openings.name: Boca Paddle by CityPickle and Farmer's Kitchen
openings.note: New 25-court pickleball and padel club with Farmer's Kitchen dining and lounges, the first building in the new public North Park

openings.name: Maman
openings.where: Sundy Village, Atlantic and Swinton avenues
openings.note: NYC French bakery cafe now pouring coffee and serving sandwiches and pastries from one of Sundy Village's historic houses

openings.name: Joe's Pizza
openings.note: Hollywood kosher pizzeria's first Palm Beach County spot, in the former Jimmy Brooklyn's Pizza Parlor space

openings.name: The Gringo
openings.note: Local Argentinian empanada favorite moved from SE Fifth Avenue to a bigger space across from PopStroke

openings.name: Limani Grille
openings.where: Town Center at Boca Raton (former Grand Lux Cafe)
openings.note: New York Greek seafood restaurant's first Florida location, with a raw bar and whole fish off the grill

openings.name: Preface Wine
openings.note: Wine shop by day that turns into a wine bar at 4 p.m., from Instagram wine educator Jonathan Frutkin

openings.name: Crema Gourmet
openings.note: All-day European-style breakfast and lunch cafe adds a West Boca location

openings.name: Madame Smash
openings.note: Counter-service wagyu smashburgers with a sauce bar and Belgian-style fries; soft opens Nov 27, grand opening Dec 11

openings.name: CaliBurger
openings.where: 508 Via De Palmas, Royal Palm Place
openings.note: California-style burger concept's first Florida location; team targeted 2026 but has not set a date

openings.name: BrickTop's
openings.note: Nashville-based steak, seafood and sushi restaurant, its third in Palm Beach County
